entities.name: Duler Sanctum
entities.description: Pristine home of the Duler Angels on Lat-Nam in the Terisian Isles of Dominaria.

entities.name: Duler Angels
entities.description: Angels of human origin living on Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Island of the Terisian Isles where the Duler Angels live.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Arrived on Lat-Nam with a retinue and later parleyed with the Duler Angels.

entities.name: Kuni
entities.description: Member of Greensleeves' retinue whose sword killed a captured angel.

events.summary: Greensleeves' retinue is attacked by the Duler Angels on Lat-Nam and beats them back, killing a few.
events.quote: they were soon attacked by the Duler Angels.

events.summary: A captured angel kills himself on Kuni's sword.
events.quote: One was captured, but killed himself on Kuni 's sword.

events.summary: Greensleeves shows the angels the Stone Brain and parleys with them, ending hostilities.
events.quote: earning their respect and ceasing the hostilities.

relations.quote: Duler Sanctum is the home of the Duler Angels of Lat-Nam
